pages.text: The $(item)Gas Packet Encoder/$ creates $(item)Gas Packets/$ filled with gases.$(p)This machine requires power.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)Gas Packet Encoder/$, place next to a gas container, and place a template gas container or a gas drop inside.$(p)You can then specify the amount of gas the created $(item)Gas Packet/$ should contain.

pages.title: Usage (cont.)
pages.text: Finally, apply a redstone signal to the machine to create the packet.$(p)The created packet will be ejected into adjacent inventories.
